description: Find artists, theorists, groups, spaces, artworks, videos, annotations, events and contributors (annotation authors). Combine free text (accent-insensitive, all words must match, "quotes" for a phrase) with filters: types, lang, year range (overlap), topics, place, related_to. Returns short records (id, type, name, years, summary, url); use the get tool (artlist-get) for details. Page with offset / next_offset.

annotation_author.description: Only records with an annotation written by this contributor (contributor record id).

in.description: "name" = match only names/titles (best for finding a person or work); "all" (default) = also biographies, exhibitions, bibliographies and other texts.

lang.description: Language version: "cs" (default — the complete version; the English translation is partial and not extended, so prefer cs and translate yourself), "en", or "any".

query.description: Free text, e.g. a surname, technique, place or exhibition title.

related_to.description: Only records linked to this record id (either direction).

topics.description: Topic / keyword names (all must match; accent-insensitive, prefix allowed), e.g. ["feminismus"]. See facets for the list.

types.description: Limit to these record types: artist, theorist, group, space, artwork, video, annotation, post, contributor.

year_from.description: Records active / dated in or after this year.

year_to.description: Records active / dated in or before this year.

name: artlist-search
title: Search the Artlist archive
